nodes.label: Shell HTML Template
nodes.rationale: Page template (CSS) with a /*BUNDLE*/ placeholder where the esbuild bundle is injected to produce public/index.html.

nodes.label: /*BUNDLE*/ Placeholder
nodes.rationale: Marker inside the script tag of shell.html that the build replaces with the bundled game JavaScript.

nodes.label: Shell Layout Structure
nodes.rationale: Layout: #app column with #main (player chips #sc, board #bw with #bd svg, #die overlay, zoom controls #zc) and #side (status bar #bar with step header #stph, status #st, hand #hand, card detail #cd, buttons #bt; collapsible log #lgd). Overlay #ov for modals. Landscape media query moves #side beside the board.
